text:
kevin: Heads up — noticed a set of billing events for tenant org_102 got partial credits this morning after the ingest fanout priority tweak. Dashboard shows provisional token count ~30% lower than final invoice delta. Anyone seen this pattern?

sujata: saw a spike in routed-to-secondary queue around 03:12 UTC. some events got stamped with priority=low and then dedup window dropped them during reconciliation.

maria: confirm. the fanout change added a parallel low-priority path for non-urgent analytics which may skip immediate crediting. not sure if downstream reconciler treats those as final.

alex: logs from router: 
``` 
INFO router: event_id=evt_9a1f priority=low routed_to=analytics-fanout shard=7
WARN deduper: skipping candidate evt_9a1f window=30s reason=delayed-arrival
```

kevin: that's the one. product teams are seeing invoice deltas and users are pinging support. need a short-term mitigation + longer fix.

thomas: short term — can we mark low-priority credits as "provisional" in the console and not show them as final until reconciliation? that would reduce confusion.

billing-bot: SYSTEM: invoice pipeline status changed to PARTIAL_FINALIZATION for tenant org_102 at 03:48 UTC.

devex: +1 on provisional flag. UX idea: show a small badge and hover tooltip -> "Provisional credit: awaiting final dedupe/reconcile". quick to add to the list route.

sujata: tech tradeoff: pipeline currently writes only finalised events to billing_events table. introducing provisional requires a new flag and aggregation path. should be doable in a patch.

alex: alternative quick fix: widen dedupe window for low-priority path from 30s to 90s to reduce false drops while we change schema. but that increases memory in deduper.

maria: can we instead push low-priority events through the same deduper instance as high-priority? avoids window change but could add load to primary.

sujata: primary deduper is already near 70% mem on peak. pushing more will risk OOM. not ideal.

kevin: Proposed plan: 1) emergency: console shows provisional counts for 24h and adds help text; 2) 48h: patch pipeline to emit billing_event.provisional boolean and include origin_path; 3) 2-week: backfill reconciliation for affected tenants and add alerting on provisional > 5% of daily credits.

thomas: sounds reasonable. product ok with provisional UI for now?

thomas: yes, will brief support and CS on messaging.

devex: I'll draft the tooltip copy and a small console banner: "Some credits are provisional while we complete reconciliation — invoice may change."

ops-bot: quick query that found affected tenants: 
``` 
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as provisional_count
FROM events_staging
WHERE routed_path = 'analytics-fanout' AND arrived_at BETWEEN '2025-11-03T03:00:00Z' AND '2025-11-03T04:00:00Z'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY provisional_count DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

kevin: thanks. action items: @sujata implement provisional flag in pipeline (P0 patch), @devex add console badge and banner (P0), @alex run capacity simulation for deduper if we widen window (investigate), @thomas coordinate CS messaging.

sujata: taking P0, will open PR tomorrow and include migration notes for billing backfill.

alex: will run load sim today and post numbers here by EOD.

maria: also recommend we add a dashboard metric: percent_provisional = provisional_events / total_billing_events per tenant. trigger alert if > 5% sustained for 2 hours.

kevin: good call. add that to the telemetry board.

billing-bot: NOTE: retro plan created -> billing/incident-2025-11-03-provisional-credit-delta. assigned: @sujata, @devex, @alex.

kevin: thanks all. will follow up in 24h with state. :thumbsup:
